Client 2026-11-05: the plush is a Pudgy product (Q7), so this stays ad_merch and does not flip. | Polly pulls a plush doll out of the shipping box (first visible f126) and shows it off with sparkles (f134-146), then hugs it with her eyes closed. The doll is a black-and-white penguin with yellow feet, a rose sweater and a navy bow: not a lead, but it reads as a Pudgy plush product being unboxed, so dropped as ad_merch under the 2026-11-04 curator ruling (Pudgy's own merch shown as a product). If the client says it is not merch, f125-162 is otherwise keepable (locked, Polly visible, no overlay). Hard cut at f163 on the same flat background (not in profile): Polly and her box vanish

spans.view: with a cream tabletop in front of him

beats.text: A cardboard box with red warning print flies in from the right, lands on the table and tumbles over to the left
Pax slides in from the right and stops beside the box, looking at it
Pax leans in and wraps his flippers around the box
Pax lifts the box up to his chest and squeezes it with his eyes shut tight
Pax bursts the box apart and a pair of teal headphones and packing peanuts fly out
Pax flings his flippers out wide, staring at the headphones lying among the packing peanuts
Pax lowers his flippers and scoops the headphones up off the table
Pax holds the headphones up by the band, looking them over and squeezing his eyes shut for a moment
Pax holds the headphones out in front of him as sparkles twinkle beside them, smiling with his beak open
Pax slips the headphones onto his head and smiles with his eyes closed
Pax holds the ear cups with both flippers and looks ahead with his eyes open and his beak slightly open
Pax closes his eyes again in a blissful smile, still holding the ear cups
